        ROUND(CAST((("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'bandwidth_util_pct')::numeric * ("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'data_size_mb')::numeric / NULLIF(("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'duration_min')::numeric, '0')) AS numeric), 2) AS bandwidth_saturation_index,
        ROUND(CAST((("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / NULLIF(("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1, 0)) AS numeric), 4) AS data_transfer_efficiency
    FROM "DataFlow"

SELECT * FROM flow_metrics

    SELECT 
        "DataFlow"."RecordRegistry",
        ("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'bandwidth_util_pct')::numeric * ("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'data_size_mb')::numeric / NULLIF(("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'duration_min')::numeric, '0') AS bsi,
        ("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / NULLIF(("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1, 0) AS dte
    FROM "DataFlow"
    WHERE ("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'bandwidth_util_pct')::numeric > 50
      AND ("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / NULLIF(("DataFlow".flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1, 0) < 1.0
)
SELECT 
    hp."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id,
    hp."routing_data"->>'origin_country' || ' -> ' || hp."routing_data"->>'destination_country' AS transfer_path,
    ROUND(CAST((hp."reliability_score"::numeric * (hp."success_pct"::numeric / NULLIF(hp."error_count"::numeric + 1, 0))) AS numeric), 2) AS dfs
FROM (
    SELECT 
        hp.*,
